title: Kymenlaakso, €1,000,000 a year: start with the curative-treatment gap
markdown:
# Kymenlaakso, €1,000,000 a year: start with the curative-treatment gap

## The gap in one sentence
In 2019–2023, 19.3% of Kymenlaakso's lung cancer patients received curative-intent treatment, compared with 27.0% nationally, the third-worst of 22 counties [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. At the top-quartile county rate of 30.4%, the gap comes to about 13.1 patients a year (arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate) [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 171 days (158–185) from first symptom to treatment start, the second longest of 23 counties, against an estimated 155 nationally [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The largest estimated excess is before the first primary care contact: 69 days (59–81), against 56 nationally [^model]. The model links this to measured local indicators using assumed weights. Daily smoking is 12.0% against 9.1% nationally [^sotkanet_4404]. Going short of care for lack of money is 24.0% against 22.9% [^sotkanet_4263]. Colorectal screening participation is 70.0% against 73.5% [^sotkanet_6103]. Diagnosis to treatment start is measured only for the Southern Finland (HUS) collaborative area [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28]. Weighted by the county's treatment mix, it comes to 38.1 days against 36.9 nationally, and surgery takes 46 days in HUS against 37 nationally [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
1. **What:** A "Be Clear on Cancer"-style campaign telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor, aimed at groups who present late [^model]. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society nationally; county communications and primary care locally [^model]. **Cost:** €12,510 a year, scaled from the roadmap's €400,000 national budget. Repeating it yearly is an assumption [^model][^roadmap_1.3.2]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; an estimated 0.48 deaths avoided a year (0.21–0.73) [^model]. **Evidence:** During the English campaign the stage I share rose 3.1 points (before-after design; the regional pilot was not significant) [^ev_symptom_campaign_1]. **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, national symptom-awareness communication plan [^roadmap_1.3.2].
2. **What:** Low-dose CT with cessation support for long-term heavy smokers aged 50–74 [^model]. **Owner:** The Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko decide; the Cancer Registry steers; the county delivers [^model]. **Cost:** €488,594 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; an estimated 3.77 deaths avoided a year in the plan (standalone 3.91, 2.87–4.96), with the benefit arriving after years [^model]. **Evidence:** Nine pooled trials gave a mortality rate ratio of 0.84 (0.76–0.92) [^ev_ldct_screening_1][^ev_ldct_screening_2]. **Roadmap:** 2.3.4, new national screening programmes [^roadmap_2.3.4].
3. **What:** Cessation medication and counselling for every smoker at the first specialist visit [^model]. **Owner:** Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology [^model]. **Cost:** €48,280 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; an estimated 0.21 deaths avoided a year in the plan (standalone 0.4, 0.27–0.51) [^model]. **Evidence:** In an observational cohort, quitting after diagnosis was associated with a hazard ratio of 0.67 (0.53–0.85) [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific care pathways [^roadmap_3.1.2].

None of these three shortens the pathway [^model]. A standardised pathway (an estimated 13 days saved) and same-day chest X-ray reporting (an estimated 18 days saved) rank next [^model]. The whole plan costs €945,103 for an estimated 4.97 deaths avoided (3.78–6.2) [^model].

## What to measure from Monday
- Date of first symptom and first primary care contact, which are not recorded anywhere nationally [^model].
- Referral date and first pulmonology visit for suspected lung cancer [^model].
- First specialist visit, diagnosis and treatment start dates by hospital [^model].
- Stage at diagnosis [^model].

## Limits of this analysis
The step days are county-level estimates, built from national medians and assumed, unfitted weights. They are not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. The 155-day national total was reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979]. As a check, not a validation, 0 of 3 measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock beyond chance; for curative-intent share, rho was −0.30 (p 0.17) [^model].
